one_month_reasoning: Q3 FY26 results fall inside the window: FORM has reported on a Wednesday each quarter (2025-10-29, 2026-04-29, 2026-07-29 per EDGAR 8-K dates) and a calendar listing shows 2026-10-28 (not yet company-confirmed). A beat on the $270M/$0.86 guide is likely (beat in Q1 and Q2), but the 10-Q shows $7-9M of IEEPA tariff refunds land in Q3 and the call summaries put one-offs at ~300bp of the 54% GM guide; the 10-Q also says Farmers Branch starts production late Q4 FY26, with start-up costs ($11.9M in H1, now in opex) moving into COGS as it ramps. So the Q4 margin/EPS guide is likely to step down versus a flattered Q3, after a ~55% one-month run on a single sell-side note. That modestly offsets post-beat drift and momentum; SK hynix Q3 (late Oct) is a read-across. I centre slightly below the actual $149.15 close (~$147.5) with ~19% one-month log-vol plus a 15% weight at 30% for an earnings gap of +/-15-20%.

fair_value.method: Blend of forward P/E on a clean (one-off-stripped) EPS path (2028E non-GAAP EPS $4.15 x 31x + ~$5.0/sh net cash at Oct 2027 = $134, weight 0.6) and an SBC-adjusted FCF yield (2028E FCF after SBC $3.07/sh / 2.5% + $5.0 cash = $128, weight 0.4) gives ~$132, about 11% below the $149 close.

bear.story: HBM/memory capex pauses in 2027 (SK hynix 24-30% of revenue), Technoprobe takes HBM4/GPU share, Nvidia second source slips, GM settles at/below 51% as Farmers Branch costs hit COGS; 2028E EPS ~$3.3 x 22x + $5 cash.

base.story: Clean EPS grows from ~$3.0 (FY26) to $3.55 (FY27) and ~$4.15 (FY28); the multiple compresses from ~48x clean run-rate to ~32x forward, so the stock drifts a little below today's level.

bull.story: HBM4/HBM4E test intensity plus a real Nvidia GPU second-source ramp (DB: >$200M by 2028) and Farmers Branch margin accretion lift FY28 EPS to ~$5.2, and the market keeps a ~43x AI-test multiple.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$85 the stock would be under the early-September low (~$92-96), ~43% off the $149 close and ~22x clean 2027E EPS of $3.55 net of cash, which most likely means the AI/HBM test cycle has turned (a Q4 guide cut beyond the expected loss of one-off margin, an HBM order cut from SK hynix, visible share loss to Technoprobe, a failed Nvidia ramp, or GM stuck below the ~51% underlying baseline once Farmers Branch costs hit COGS), not ordinary volatility.

key_uncertainties: Clean earnings power: Q3 guide is flattered by ~300bp of one-offs ($7-9M tariff refunds plus metal reclaims); underlying GM ~51% and how fast Farmers Branch moves it toward the 55% target.
Duration of the memory/HBM capex cycle into 2027-28; SK hynix was 29.5% of Q1 and 24.3% of Q2 revenue, and the stock has had two ~60% drawdowns in five years.
Nvidia GPU second-source ramp: one sell-side note (DB); Nvidia was a 10.2% customer in Q1 2026 but under 10% in Q2, unquantified by the company.
Competition: Technoprobe growing faster (+42% H1, 2026 guide EUR1.05-1.10bn) and ranked #1 by TrendForce for 2026.
Valuation: ~48x clean run-rate EPS leaves little room for a soft Q4 guide.
reasoning: Round 2 changes are driven by the supervisor's fact-checks, which I verified in the Q2 10-Q: FORM expects $7.0-9.0M of IEEPA tariff refunds in Q3, and call summaries put one-offs (refunds plus metal reclaims) at ~300bp of the 54% GM guide, so clean Q3 EPS is ~$0.77, not $0.86 [18,20]. I had annualized the flattered guide; re-basing lowers FY27E from $3.90 to $3.55 and FY28E from $4.40 to $4.15. The 10-Q also confirms Farmers Branch production starts late Q4 FY26 with start-up costs moving into COGS during the FY27 ramp, a near-term margin headwind before a 2028 benefit [18]. Customer facts corrected from the 10-Qs: Nvidia 10.2% in Q1 2026 only, SK hynix 29.5% Q1 / 24.3% Q2 [18,19]; the stock3 column was directionally right but stale. The DB Nvidia thesis stays a single sell-side source, so it lives in the bull case, not the base. The FCF leg was rebuilt with explicit D&A, working capital, capex and SBC (H1 OCF $106.8M, capex $24.8M, SBC $16.7M) and now gives $128 instead of $138. Fresh alternative/in-lane checks added little: HBM4 commentary (Finterra, TrendForce abstract) says FORM supplies all top-3 HBM makers but Technoprobe leads overall and in foundry/logic [23,24]; Reddit/X still gave no usable signal. Fair value falls from $142 to $132 (~11% below the $149.15 close; I sit slightly below the supervisor's $135 because I also haircut the multiple to 31x for Technoprobe's faster growth and deduct SBC in the FCF leg). Distribution: a lognormal mixture with median ~$141 (between fair value and spot, as momentum names often hold premiums), 80% weight at 58% vol and 20% at 95% for cycle-turn and AI-bull regimes; the history of ~60% drawdowns supports a fat left tail (P(<$59) ~9%). Result: P(>=148) 0.47, P(>=89) 0.77, P(>=259) 0.16. Upper tail trimmed ~0.5-1pt versus the raw mixture given the lower clean EPS base.
